levels.title: First Pickup
levels.briefing: Tap to move. Tap a robot to shoot. Take the Seeker and escape.

levels.title: Blind Corner
levels.briefing: Use the loop to escape the drone. Guards search where they last saw you.

levels.title: Crossfire
levels.briefing: Break one firing lane, then cross behind cover.

levels.title: Loading Lockdown
levels.briefing: Scout the return loop before taking the phone.

levels.title: Skybridge
levels.briefing: Cross at a safe gap. Reinforcements arrive after the pickup alarm.

levels.title: Heavy Watch
levels.briefing: Flank the Heavy while its weapon recovers.

levels.title: Split Route
levels.briefing: The outside loop is safer. The middle route is shorter.

levels.title: Twin Relay
levels.briefing: Two phones. Clear a route you can use twice.

levels.title: Dark Circuit
levels.briefing: Tap the switch, pass the open gate, then collect the phone.

levels.title: Vault Window
levels.briefing: Wait in cover for the exit to turn mint.

levels.title: Security Grid
levels.briefing: Break contact between rooms. Nearby guards share sightings.

levels.title: Last Seeker
levels.briefing: Use the bends for cover. Flank the Warden and take the last Seeker.
